title: feat(github): connect personal accounts alongside the system account

commit.messageHeadline: feat(github): add personal connections and explicit publication identity
refactor(github): consolidate connection and publication owners
fix(ui): repair GitHub integration checks and startup loading
test(ui): declare login dependency in gateway lineage fixtures
fix(ui): allow personal publication after workspace reclaim
fix(protocol): complete GitHub publication models on mobile

<!-- clawsweeper-pr-ack:opened item=133799 -->
🦞👀
ClawSweeper picked this up.

Pull request received. I will update this pull request when review starts.

@clawsweeper re-review

Refreshed onto main and fixed personal publication from reclaimed workspaces by reusing the existing placement predicate. The regression failed before the fix; 130 publication/recovery cases, 74 browser cases, the full configured changed check, and the artifact build now pass. The body records proof and follow-ups. Real GitHub consent and Gateway-brokered personal publication remain pending and are still landing gates.

See [Decision needed](#decision-needed). ## Review scores | Measure | Result | What it means | |---|---|---| | **Overall readiness** | 🧂 unranked krab **(1/6)** | PR readiness rating was derived from proof quality, review findings, security review, and reviewer confidence. | | **Proof confidence** | 🌊 off-meta tidepool | Not applicable: Real behavior proof is not required for maintainer- or bot-authored pull requests. | | **Patch quality** | 🧂 unranked krab **(1/6)** | Security review found an item that needs attention. | ## Verification | Check | Result | Evidence | |---|---|---| | **Real behavior** | Not applicable | Not applicable: Real behavior proof is not required for maintainer- or bot-authored pull requests. | | **Evidence reviewed** | 7 items | Closure-bound authorization: The introduced personal-action owner is derived from a current authenticated human Gateway connection and revalidated for profile, role, scope, abort state, and live connection membership.
Final-effect checks: The executor invokes authority validation immediately before and after both the Git push and draft pull-request creation.
Mocked stale-authority coverage: The test injects socket, scope, disconnect, reconnect, profile-merge, and session changes immediately before push and asserts no mocked push or POST occurs. | | **Findings** | None | None. | | **Security** | Needs attention | Real stale-authority denial is unproven: Mocked tests show intended checks, but no redacted real Gateway run demonstrates that disconnect or reassignment is rejected before GitHub push and draft-PR creation. | ## How this fits together A human Control UI connection asks the Gateway to publish work from a session using that person’s GitHub account. The Gateway verifies the live profile, session, workspace, and OAuth selection before invoking Git and GitHub to push a branch and create a draft pull request. ```mermaid flowchart LR A[Authenticated human connection] --> B[Gateway publication request] B --> C[Profile, scope, and session checks] C --> D[Reserved workspace and publication record] D --> E[GitHub credential refresh] E --> F[Push branch and create draft PR] ``` ## Decision needed | Question | Recommendation | |---|---| | May this personal GitHub publication boundary merge without real final-effect authorization proof? | **Require redacted real boundary proof:** Demonstrate an allowed owner completing OAuth and publication, then prove disconnect and reassignment reject before push or PR creation. | Why: Mocks cover intended fencing, but only a real Gateway and GitHub transport can establish that stale or reassigned authority is rejected before an external effect. ## Before merge - [ ] **Resolve security concern: Real stale-authority denial is unproven** - Mocked tests show intended checks, but no redacted real Gateway run demonstrates that disconnect or reassignment is rejected before GitHub push and draft-PR creation. - [ ] **Resolve merge risk (P1)** - Mocked command and Gateway tests do not establish that a real OAuth-selected identity is denied before GitHub push or draft-PR I/O after disconnect or profile reassignment. - [ ] **Resolve merge risk (P1)** - This adds a persistent personal-publication and OAuth path alongside existing shared publication behavior, so upgrade and operator behavior remain compatibility-sensitive until the real flow is exercised. - [ ] **Complete next step (P2)** - Protected maintainer review should require real, redacted final-effect authorization evidence; this is not a safe automated repair dispatch. - [ ] **Improve patch quality** - Resolve the security review concern or explain why the changed path is safe. ## Findings - [medium] Real stale-authority denial is unproven — `src/gateway/github-publication-executor.ts:485`
Agent review details ### Security Needs attention: No concrete code bypass was found, but this authority-changing OAuth and publication path lacks real final-effect proof. ### PR surface PR surface statistics unavailable: the file list is incomplete. ### Review metrics | Metric | Value | Why it matters | |---|---|---| | **PR-reported implementation size** | production +3,830; tests/support +4,230 | This is a large cross-layer feature, so the protected maintainer review and real authorization proof must cover the end-to-end boundary rather than only unit paths. | ### Stored data model Persistent data-model change detected: `serialized state: scripts/protocol-gen-kotlin.ts`, `serialized state: src/agents/worktrees/registry.ts`, `serialized state: src/agents/worktrees/run-lease-owner.ts`, `unknown-data-model-change: packages/gateway-protocol/src/schema/session-github-publication.ts`, `unknown-data-model-change: packages/gateway-protocol/src/schema/users.ts`, `unknown-data-model-change: scripts/protocol-gen-kotlin.ts`, and 3 more. Confirm migration or upgrade compatibility proof before merge. ### Root-cause cluster Relationship: `fixed_by_candidate` Canonical: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/133590 Summary: This PR is the candidate implementation of the accepted personal GitHub connection and publication feature in #133590. Members: - `canonical`: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/133590 - The branch’s feature-introduction commit explicitly references this accepted design issue. - `adjacent_distinct`: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/134351 - The related merged work addresses a separate GitHub credential-handling concern and does not replace personal publication. Proposal only: this assessment does not dispatch repair, suppress jobs, mutate sibling items, close, or merge anything. ### Merge-risk options **Maintainer options:** 1. **Prove final authorization at real GitHub I/O (recommended)** Add a redacted real Gateway run covering allowed publication and stale-owner rejection before both push and draft-PR creation. 2. **Pause until a safe proof environment exists** Do not merge the personal-publication path until real OAuth and final-effect authority proof can be captured without exposing credentials.
Copy recommended automerge instruction ```text @clawsweeper automerge Special instructions: Require redacted real Gateway proof of allowed personal publication and disconnect/reassignment denial before push and draft-PR creation. ```
### Technical review Best possible solution: Add redacted real Gateway proof for successful device authorization, account selection, push, and draft PR creation, plus disconnect and ownership-reassignment denial before final I/O. Do we have a high-confidence way to reproduce the issue? Not applicable: this is a feature PR, not a report of broken existing behavior; its mocked authority scenarios are source-readable but not real-effect reproduction evidence. Is this the best way to solve the issue? Unclear: closure-bound checks at the publication owner and final-effect executor are the appropriate design direction, but the required real authorization proof is absent. AGENTS.md: found and applied where relevant. Codex review notes: model internal, reasoning high; reviewed against [02a509a3277f](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/02a509a3277f21798cae4d0fda725397834d83e4). ### Labels Label justifications: - `P1`: The PR introduces a security-sensitive publication workflow that can create external GitHub effects and is not yet proven at its final boundary. - `merge-risk: 🚨 compatibility`: It adds new persisted personal-publication state and alters how existing session publication flows select credentials and owners. - `merge-risk: 🚨 auth-provider`: The new device OAuth and account-selection path determines which GitHub credential may publish. - `merge-risk: 🚨 security-boundary`: A live human connection’s authority is carried to Git push and draft-PR creation, but real stale-authority denial remains unproven. - `rating: 🧂 unranked krab`: Overall readiness is 🧂 unranked krab; proof is 🌊 off-meta tidepool and patch quality is 🧂 unranked krab. - `status: ⏳ waiting on author`: ClawSweeper has contributor-facing work open and is waiting for author action. Not applicable: Real behavior proof is not required for maintainer- or bot-authored pull requests. ### Evidence Security concerns: - [medium] Real stale-authority denial is unproven — `src/gateway/github-publication-executor.ts:485` Mocked tests show intended checks, but no redacted real Gateway run demonstrates that disconnect or reassignment is rejected before GitHub push and draft-PR creation. Confidence: 0.94 Acceptance criteria: - [P1] Run a redacted real Gateway device-OAuth flow with the intended owner, selected account, push, and draft-PR creation. - [P1] Repeat with disconnect immediately before push and profile reassignment immediately before draft-PR creation; verify each rejects before external I/O. What I checked: - **Closure-bound authorization:** The introduced personal-action owner is derived from a current authenticated human Gateway connection and revalidated for profile, role, scope, abort state, and live connection membership. ([`src/gateway/server-methods/github-personal-authorization.ts:120`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/95685a9624ea/src/gateway/server-methods/github-personal-authorization.ts#L120), [95685a9624ea](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/95685a9624ea)) - **Final-effect checks:** The executor invokes authority validation immediately before and after both the Git push and draft pull-request creation. ([`src/gateway/github-publication-executor.ts:483`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/95685a9624ea/src/gateway/github-publication-executor.ts#L483), [95685a9624ea](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/95685a9624ea)) - **Mocked stale-authority coverage:** The test injects socket, scope, disconnect, reconnect, profile-merge, and session changes immediately before push and asserts no mocked push or POST occurs. ([`src/gateway/github-personal-publication.test.ts:470`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/95685a9624ea/src/gateway/github-personal-publication.test.ts#L470), [95685a9624ea](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/95685a9624ea)) - **External GitHub API boundary:** Credential verification directly calls GitHub’s fixed /user endpoint with bearer authentication and redirect refusal, making real OAuth/API behavior part of this feature’s proof requirement. ([`src/agents/github-oauth-client.ts:286`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/95685a9624ea/src/agents/github-oauth-client.ts#L286), [95685a9624ea](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/95685a9624ea)) - **Separate durable request ownership:** Personal publication requests are persisted in a new table explicitly separated from older shared publication requests, carrying owner, connection generation, session, identity, and effect facts. ([`src/state/openclaw-state-schema.sql:2178`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/95685a9624ea/src/state/openclaw-state-schema.sql#L2178), [95685a9624ea](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/95685a9624ea)) - **Current-main necessity:** Fetched main still exposes only the shared session publication coordinator; it has no personal GitHub implementation under the affected Gateway, agent, state, or protocol paths. ([`src/gateway/server-methods/sessions-github.ts:12`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/02a509a3277f/src/gateway/server-methods/sessions-github.ts#L12), [02a509a3277f](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/02a509a3277f)) Likely related people: - **steipete:** Suggested for follow-up; no historical authorship or introduction is verified. (role: unverified routing candidate; confidence: low) ### Rating scale | Score | Internal tier | Crab rank | Meaning | |---:|:---:|---|---| | **6/6** | S | 🦀 challenger crab | Exceptional readiness | | **5/6** | A | 🦞 diamond lobster | Very strong readiness | | **4/6** | B | 🐚 platinum hermit | Good normal PR; ordinary maintainer review | | **3/6** | C | 🦐 gold shrimp | Useful, but confidence is limited | | **2/6** | D | 🦪 silver shellfish | Proof or implementation needs work | | **1/6** | F | 🧂 unranked krab | Not merge-ready | | N/A | NA | 🌊 off-meta tidepool | Rating does not apply | Overall follows the weaker of proof and patch quality. Shiny media proof means a screenshot, video, or linked artifact directly shows the changed behavior. Runtime, network, CSP, and security claims still need visible diagnostics. ### Workflow - ClawSweeper keeps one durable marker-backed review comment per issue or PR. - Re-runs edit this comment so the latest verdict, findings, and automation markers stay together instead of adding duplicate bot comments. - A fresh review can be triggered by eligible `@clawsweeper re-review` comments, exact-item GitHub events, scheduled/background review runs, or manual workflow dispatch. - PR/issue authors and users with repository write access can comment `@clawsweeper re-review` or `@clawsweeper re-run` on an open PR or issue to request a fresh review only. - Maintainers can also comment `@clawsweeper review` to request a fresh review only. - Fresh-review commands do not start repair, autofix, rebase, CI repair, or automerge. - Maintainer-only repair and merge flows require explicit commands such as `@clawsweeper autofix`, `@clawsweeper automerge`, `@clawsweeper fix ci`, or `@clawsweeper address review`. - Maintainers can comment `@clawsweeper explain` to ask for more context, or `@clawsweeper stop` to stop active automation. ### History
